cases.name: scalars
cases.code: a=hello; b=; declare -p a b; typeset -p a

cases.name: attributes
cases.code: x=value; export x; readonly x; declare -p x; declare -prx x; declare -p x; echo "$x"

cases.name: raw references
cases.code: v=value; declare -n b=v; declare -n a=b; declare -p a b v

cases.name: cycles
cases.code: declare -n a=b; declare -n b=a; declare -p a b

cases.name: missing target
cases.code: declare -n a=absent; declare -p a; declare -p absent

cases.name: operand continuation
cases.code: a=one; b=two; declare -p missing a absent b; echo status:$?; declare -p missing

cases.name: typeset continuation
cases.code: a=one; typeset -p missing a; echo status:$?

cases.name: function is not variable
cases.code: f(){ :; }; declare -p f

cases.name: never localizes
cases.code: x=global; f(){ declare -p x; x=changed; }; f; declare -p x

cases.name: local unset empty
cases.code: f(){ local unset empty=; declare -p unset empty; }; f

cases.name: local readonly scope
cases.code: x=global; f(){ local x=inner; readonly x; declare -p x; g(){ local x=deep; declare -p x; }; g; declare -p x; }; f; declare -p x

cases.name: nested local unset metadata
cases.code: f(){ local -rx u; g(){ declare -p u; }; g; }; f; declare -p u

cases.name: unset reference target metadata
cases.code: f(){ local -r target; declare -n ref=target; declare -p ref target; }; f

cases.name: local export scope
cases.code: x=outer; export x; f(){ local x=inner; declare -p x; }; f; declare -p x

cases.name: unset attributes
cases.code: export x; readonly y; declare -p x y

cases.name: reference attribute
cases.code: x=value; declare -n r=x; readonly r; declare -p r x

cases.name: utf8
cases.code: v="é中🙂"; declare -p v

cases.name: C byte escapes
cases.code: LC_ALL=C; v="é中🙂"; declare -p v

cases.name: utf8 controls
cases.code: v=$'é\n中\u0085\u2028🙂'; declare -p v

cases.name: closed stdout
cases.code: v=kept; declare -p v 1>&-; echo status:$?; echo "$v"

cases.name: closed stderr
cases.code: v=kept; declare -p absent v 2>&-; echo status:$?

cases.name: duplicate names
cases.code: x=value; declare -pp -- x x

cases.name: assignment operand
cases.code: x=old; declare -p x=new; echo "$?:$x"

cases.name: unset reference recreation
cases.code:
target="hello"
declare -n ref=target
echo "before: $ref"
unset -n ref
echo "after unset -n:"
declare -p ref 2>/dev/null || echo "ref gone"
declare -n ref=target
echo "recreated: $ref"

cases.name: unset reference chain
cases.code: v=ok; declare -n a=v; declare -n b=a; unset -n b; declare -p a v; declare -p b 2>/dev/null; echo "missing:$?"

cases.name: unset reference cycle
cases.code: declare -n a=b; declare -n b=a; unset -n a; declare -p a 2>/dev/null; echo "missing:$?"; declare -p b

cases.name: unset reference keeps ordinary names
cases.code: v=ok; f(){ echo function; }; unset -n v f absent; declare -p v; f; echo "status:$?"

cases.name: unset reference readonly target
cases.code: readonly t=ok; declare -n r=t; unset -n r; echo "status:$?"; declare -p r 2>/dev/null; echo "missing:$?"; declare -p t

cases.name: unset current local reference
cases.code: r=global; t=target; f(){ local -n r=t; unset -n r; declare -p r; }; f; declare -p r t

cases.name: unset caller local reference
cases.code: r=global; t=target; f(){ local -n r=t; g(){ unset -n r; declare -p r; }; g; declare -p r; }; f; declare -p r t

cases.name: unset reference function option
cases.code: f(){ echo old; }; declare -n f=target; target=kept; unset -nf f; declare -p f target; f 2>/dev/null; echo "function:$?"

cases.name: unset reference variable option
cases.code: v=ok; declare -n r=v; unset -nv r; declare -p v; declare -p r 2>/dev/null; echo "missing:$?"

cases.name: unset IFS reference
cases.code: sep=:; declare -n IFS=sep; unset -n IFS; value="a b"; printf "<%s>\n" $value; declare -p sep; declare -p IFS 2>/dev/null; echo "missing:$?"

cases.name: unset-n readonly scalar
cases.code: readonly v=ok; unset -n v; echo "status:$?"; declare -p v

cases.name: unset-n readonly unset scalar
cases.code: readonly v; unset -n v; echo "status:$?"; declare -p v

cases.name: unset-n readonly current local
cases.code: f(){ local v=1; readonly v; unset -n v; echo "current:$?"; declare -p v; }; f

cases.name: unset-n readonly caller local
cases.code: f(){ local w=1; readonly w; g(){ unset -n w; echo "caller:$?"; }; g; declare -p w; }; f

cases.name: unset-n mixed readonly operands
cases.code: readonly v=1; declare -n r=v; unset -n r v; echo "status:$?"; declare -p r 2>/dev/null; echo "missing:$?"; declare -p v
